item.title: $14M in surgical robotic arms stolen from Florida hospital in multi-year scheme
item.description: A man was arrested last week in connection with a multi-year theft scheme involving millions of dollars' worth of medical equipment being stolen from a Jacksonville hospital.

item.title: 7 vehicles damaged after brush fire in Hernando County
item.description: Several vehicles were damaged Thursday afternoon after a reported brush fire in Weeki Wachee.

item.title: Florida lawmakers vote to rename airport after Trump; his company trademarks it
item.description: As Florida lawmakers move forward with plans to rename a major airport after President Donald Trump, a recent trademark filing by the Trump Organization is raising some eyebrows.

item.title: Dozens of manatees found dead around Florida river within 1 week, FWC says
item.description: Officials have seen an increasing number of manatees turning up dead in the Orange River, the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) said Thursday.

item.title: VIDEO: Truck engulfed in flames on I-75 in Hillsborough County
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA) — A truck caught fire Thursday evening on I-75 in Hillsborough County. item.title: Duke Energy takes Pinellas County power lines underground in storm hardening project
item.description: Duke Energy said the work will help keep lights on for its more than two million customers, especially after hurricanes.

item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became an advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Historic Don CeSar hotel hosts grand reopening following Hurricanes Milton, Helene
item.description: Following severe water and debris damage from both Hurricanes Milton and Helene in 2024, the iconic Don CeSar Hotel & Resort on St. Pete Beach hosted a grand reopening Thursday evening.

item.title: Tampa teen named Miracle killed during FaceTime call; 17-year-old suspect wanted
item.description: Tampa police are searching for a 17-year-old boy believed to have shot and killed another teen during a FaceTime call in January and are now turning to the public for help.

item.title: Depression in roadway shuts down westbound lanes of I-4 in Polk County
item.description: The westbound lanes of I-4 in Polk County were shut down Thursday night after a depression formed in the roadway, according to authorities.
